colours_and_clean.method: 18 render colours (medoids) + the ink, nearest colour; lone pixels take the most common neighbour

parts.method: arms and fists off left of the chest line, the chest under the arms refilled with the jumper ribs of row 34 (each column its own colour), rows 36+ dropped (the hull hides them); fists cut rows 21-31 cols 0-9, wrist closed with ink
